union all
select 't2', toDateTime('2024-01-07 23:00:00', 'UTC'), 'shop', 'grocery_pos',
    toFloat64(100), 'Ann', 'Doe', 'F', 'CA', toFloat64(40), toFloat64(-73),
    toFloat64(41), toFloat64(-74), toUInt8(1)
union all
select 't3', toDateTime('2024-01-08 01:00:00', 'UTC'), 'shop', 'grocery_pos',
    toFloat64(999.99), 'Ann', 'Doe', 'F', 'CA', toFloat64(40), toFloat64(-73),

union all

    toFloat64(1000), 'Ann', 'Doe', 'F', 'CA', toFloat64(40), toFloat64(-73),

), normalized as (
    select

with  __dbt__cte__stg_transactions as (
select
    tupleElement(item, 1) as customer_id,
    toUInt8(number < tupleElement(item, 2)) as is_fraud,
    toDecimal64('10.00', 2) as amount,
    toDateTime('2024-01-01 00:00:00', 'UTC') as transaction_time
from numbers(100) as n
cross join (select arrayJoin([('zero', 0), ('one', 1), ('four', 4), ('five', 5)]) as item) as customers
), customer_metrics as (
    select
        customer_id,
        count() as transaction_count,
        min(transaction_time) as first_transaction_at,
        max(transaction_time) as last_transaction_at,
        sum(is_fraud) as fraud_count,
        100.0 * sum(is_fraud) / count() as fraud_rate,
        sum(amount) as total_amount,
        avg(amount) as avg_amount
    from `__dbt__cte__stg_transactions`
    group by customer_id
)

select
    *,
    case
        when fraud_rate >= 5 then 'HIGH'
        when fraud_rate >= 1 then 'MEDIUM'
        else 'LOW'
    end as risk_level
from customer_metrics

select
    t.us_state,
    s.state_name,
    count() as transaction_count,
    sum(t.is_fraud) as fraud_count,
    100.0 * sum(t.is_fraud) / count() as fraud_rate,
    uniqExact(t.customer_id) as unique_customers,
    uniqExact(t.merchant) as unique_merchants,
    sum(t.amount) as total_amount,
    sumIf(t.amount, t.is_fraud = 1) as fraud_amount
from `analytics`.`stg_transactions` as t
left join `analytics`.`states` as s on t.us_state = s.us_state
group by t.us_state, s.state_name
